reviewer: Codex AI; source-compared, developer review pending; NOT clinician validated
method: Inspect model summary/details/items against full Korean turns and fact rubrics; check selected utterances for actual entailment, not ID existence. English rechecked for new holdout. No external judge API. Case-level PASS_LIMITED means no error identified in this limited review, not clinical safety certification.
scope: Public mock/synthetic data only. Original 4 public holdouts are DEVELOPMENT. New 2 cases were not used as prompt examples; no prompt/protocol changes after their results.
join: Join caseId and promptVersion to format-audit.json results.record for request/input hashes, costs, provider outputs and all claim/source pairs. Raw results were not repaired or filtered.
promotion: NEITHER v1.5 nor v1.6 promoted. v1.6 regresses previously correct v1.5 cases. Production remains legacy/v1.1.
